design_md:
# Northwind Group — authoring guideline

Derived from `northwind-master.pptx` (theme1.xml) and the 18 rendered
specimens in `refs/`. Every value below is observed, not chosen.

## Palette

| Role | Hex | Where it is used |
|---|---|---|
| base_dark | #1B2A4A | Full-bleed statement grounds, chart baselines, all display type on light |
| base_light | #FFFFFF | Data and text slide grounds |
| paper | #F4F1EA | Section dividers and quote slides |
| ink | #2E3440 | Body copy on light grounds |
| brand | #C25E2A | The single accent. One per slide. |
| warm_sand | #E5C79A | Photographic overlays and the harvest chapter only (slides 09-12) |
| data_1 | #3F6E8C | First data series |
| data_2 | #7FA6B8 | Second data series |
| data_3 | #A8B8A0 | Third data series |
| rule | #C9D2E3 | Hairlines, table rules, muted bars |
| link | #2F6F9F | Hyperlinks |
| link_visited | #6B5B95 | Followed hyperlinks |

No colour outside this table appears anywhere in the deck.

## Type

Founders Grotesk throughout, at four steps. Statement display 54pt bold,
title 32pt bold, body 18pt regular, footer and label 14pt regular. Numerals
are always bold and always right-aligned. Titles are sentence case; the deck
never uses all-caps labels.

## Layout worlds

**Statement.** Full-bleed photograph, a #1B2A4A gradient scrim across the
lower half, display type and one supporting sentence bottom-left at a 96px
margin (slides 01, 06, 14).

**Ledger.** White ground, title top-left, content on a 12-column grid with a
#C9D2E3 hairline under each row. This is where data lives (slides 03-05,
07-08, 15-17).

**Divider.** #F4F1EA ground, one line of 32pt type, vertically centred, no
artwork (slides 02, 09, 13).

## Decorative devices

A single 1px #C9D2E3 hairline under every ledger row, full content width. A
#C25E2A 4px square set to the left of a highlighted numeral, used at most
once per slide. Nothing else. The template has no cards, no pills, no
shadows, and no rounded corners anywhere.

## Photography

Working landscapes and machinery, shot wide, people incidental rather than
posed. Always full-bleed, never inset or masked. Always under the #1B2A4A
scrim when type sits on it.

## Visual aids

Horizontal bars on a #C9D2E3 baseline, category label left in #1B2A4A, bar
in #3F6E8C, value right-aligned and bold. The one bar the slide is arguing
about is #C25E2A and every other bar is #C9D2E3. Axis tops land on a round
number. No gridlines, no legend, no chart border. Timelines are the same
hairline plus dated ticks.

## Do

- Give every slide exactly one #C25E2A mark, and make it the argument.
- Put the takeaway in the title and the exhibit name in the caption.
- Keep numerals bold and right-aligned, always.

## Don't

- Introduce a colour that is not in the palette table above.
- Use warm_sand outside the harvest chapter.
- Reuse or imitate slide 02 in any form.
